purpose: Drafting only: how tools/zh_hant/sync_corpus.py writes a machine draft (zh_hant_status=draft) for a Traditional entry that is new or whose Simplified source changed. The Traditional corpora themselves are the parallel files under corpus/*-zh-hant and corpus/zh-hant.
opencc_note: s2tw converts the character standard only. Its phrase table still errs (e.g. 回归 -> 迴歸; Taiwan writes 回歸); drafts need review. s2twp is not used: its IT phrase table breaks prose (士兵 -> 計程車兵).
